deviations: New tests went into a new file, tests/unit/strategies/automation-status-session-manager-fleet.test.ts, not the existing automation-status-expected-fleet.test.ts. That file is already 305 lines, and the eslint max-lines limit is 300. The existing file is unchanged, which also proves the 'absent' case: its toEqual assertions pass byte-identical.

expected-fleet inlines a 6-line interval parser rather than importing parseLoopInterval from the lisa-secrets-access skill. Plugin-level scripts never import from skill folders, and this module is also loaded by src/cli/ui-automations-adapters.ts. The same regex and units are used.
An unparseable, zero or absent interval falls back to the 5m default. A missing name renders as "the manager's tmux session".
The RRULE is derived from the largest unit that divides the interval evenly: 120m becomes FREQ=HOURLY;INTERVAL=2 and 90s becomes FREQ=SECONDLY;INTERVAL=90.
